name: quest
entries: Recover a village's stolen shadows before sunrise; the thief is using them to build a body for a lonely spirit.
Escort an unbearable but vital diplomat through territory where speaking a lie attracts predators.
Investigate a mine where workers return each evening with memories belonging to people who vanished years ago.
Steal a cursed crown from a tyrant without letting anyone wear it, including the crown's persuasive ghost.
Find why a river has stopped flowing before two downstream towns go to war over the remaining water.
Rescue a dragon from a princess who collects rare creatures and controls the local legal system.
Map a forest that rearranges its paths whenever someone makes a decision they regret.
Deliver a sealed box to a monastery; every faction claims the box contains something different and none may be entirely wrong.
Clear a family's name by proving their executed ancestor was replaced by a mimic before committing treason.
Negotiate peace between a town and the giant whose seasonal migration now passes directly through its new walls.
Retrieve medicine from a quarantined city where the disease infects written words rather than bodies.
Stop a tournament champion who cannot lose because every defeated opponent is magically added to their strength.
Explore a lighthouse shining into the ground while ships vanish beneath nearby fields.
Return a runaway familiar to its mage, then decide whether the familiar's claim of mistreatment is true.
Protect a haunted theater's final performance so its dead playwright can reveal the murderer in the last scene.
Locate a missing tax caravan carrying no gold but a ledger capable of collapsing three noble houses.
Break into an abandoned prison to free an innocent inmate whom official records say died forty years ago.
Gather three rival runesmiths to repair a failing ward, despite each blaming the others for its sabotage.
Track a monster that steals names; its victims remain alive but cannot be remembered or addressed.
Win a cooking contest whose prize is an ancient map, while ingredients and judges are being secretly enchanted.
Recover a sacred bell from peaceful settlers who need it to keep a worse creature asleep.
Investigate an army that marches every night but leaves no footprints and has not attacked anyone.
Help a ghost complete one final promise without revealing that fulfilling it will ruin a living descendant.
Enter a noble's dream to remove an assassin, knowing wounds and secrets found there may return to reality.
Find the source of counterfeit healing potions that work perfectly but transfer injuries to random strangers.
Capture a famous outlaw before a corrupt sheriff does, then judge whether to deliver either of them.
Retrieve a meteor shard from disputed ground while the shard rapidly creates strange life around it.
Reunite the pieces of a broken treaty before its magical oath interprets the damage as a declaration of war.
Discover who is replacing town statues with petrified citizens and why the statues are smiling.
Close a portal that grants one wish to everyone nearby, with increasingly literal and destructive results.
